content: The Louisiana State University Health Sciences Center in New Orleans is situated in New Orleans, Louisiana. It encompasses six schools, including one of the two LSU medical schools, twelve Centers of Excellence, and two patient care clinics. Following the impact of Hurricane Katrina, the School of Dentistry has been temporarily relocated to Baton Rouge. The LSU Health Sciences Center School of Medicine was established in 1931. Initially, it was located at 1542 Tulane Avenue, adjacent to the newly reconstructed Charity Hospital building, which was completed in 1939. The School of Graduate Studies was founded in 1965, followed by the School of Dentistry in 1966, the School of Nursing in 1968, and the School of Allied Health Professions in 1970. The School of Public Health was later established in 2003. Hurricane Katrina caused significant damage to LSUHSC-NO, severely reducing the capacity of its two teaching hospitals, Charity Hospital and University Hospital. For 15 months, LSUHSC-NO operated without access to either hospital, necessitating the establishment of a trauma center in a vacant shopping center. While Charity Hospital was deemed unsalvageable by LSU officials, University Hospital reopened on November 20, 2006, following extensive renovations. The institution comprises the following schools: School of Allied Health Professions School of Dentistry School of Graduate Studies School of Medicine School of Nursing School of Public Health The Centers of Excellence include: Alcohol and Drug Abuse Center Cardiovascular Center Center for Molecular and Human Genetics Center for Oral and Craniofacial Biology Center on Aging Epilepsy Center Ernest N. Morial Asthma, Allergy, and Respiratory Disease Center The Gene Therapy Program LSU Eye Center Neurosciences Center The Research Institute for Children Stanley S. Scott Cancer Center The teaching hospitals associated with LSUHSC are: Charity Hospital University Hospital The clinical services include: LSU Healthcare Network LSU Health Sciences Center School of Dentistry
